messages:
rachel (docs): quick report: linkcheck is tripping on a few patterns in the migration preview — specifically mixed-case anchors and image fragments. example: `docs/examples/python#Setup (basic)` vs built `#setup-basic` and `![diagram](../assets/flow.png#diagram-1)` losing the fragment.

ton y (eng): can you paste the failing linkcheck line?

ci-bot: linkcheck: ERROR broken fragment at /examples/overview -> target /examples/python#Setup%20(basic) resolved to /examples/python#setup-basic (no match) 

maya (devex): sounds like slugifier differences and image fragment handling. two-pronged fix: normalize generated ids to kebab-case during build, and post-build repair for image fragments (move fragment into a wrapping figure id).

rachel (docs): agree. main goals: keep canonical URLs stable for external links, but make the site linkcheck-green. plan: 1) add a docusaurus slugify hook to force kebab-case 2) run a post-build comparer that emits a small redirects-fragments.json for any mismatches 3) repair image-based fragments in preview builds and log changes for authors.

ton y (eng): implementation notes: i'll add `createSlug` in docusaurus config that lowercases, removes punctuation, replaces non-alnum with '-'. post-build script will diff source->built slugs and output `build/fragment-redirects.json`.

sara (i18n): caution: translations may include punctuation or non-latin characters that slug differently. we should run the comparer across `i18n/*/site` and produce a locale-specific map so translators can opt-in to fixes or add explicit `{#id}`.

maya (devex): also want a markdownlint rule to warn when headings contain parens/spaces so authors can add explicit ids. we can autofix English docs but leave locales for manual review.

ci-bot: preview build available at https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/pr-1711  linkcheck failures reduced from 12 -> 2 (both image fragment cases).

rachel (docs): PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1711  contains slugify hook, post-build fragment redirect generator, and an image-fragment preview repair. Please review: tony for slugifier/script, maya for lint, sara for i18n risk.

ton y (eng): pushing a small unit test to validate slug outputs for a handful of real headings. will also keep redirect generation conservative (only emit entries with a mismatch).

sara (i18n): running comparer on locales now; will comment in PR for any pages needing translator attention.

rachel (docs): thanks all. after we merge, let's run a full linkcheck sweep for 48h before turning on fail-on-broken for docs PRs. ping here with regressions. :sparkles:
